networkContract.tokenizer: keep the checkpoint tokenizer fixed during an A/B experiment
networkContract.loss: mask every prefix token; compute causal loss only on suffix tokens
networkContract.runtimeCandidateStrategy: shared prefill plus independent decode branches; rank and keep three

recordContract.chainContinuation: the next turn prefix equals prefix plus completions[0]

evaluationStages.production_candidate: PredictionProvider output after provider-defined parsing and filtering
evaluationStages.raw_model_output: unparsed decode branches supplied by an explicit RawCompletionProvider or raw JSONL replay

qualityGateContract.lexicalReference: character-sequence and bigram overlap diagnostic; not a semantic score
qualityGateContract.semanticJudgment: explicit versioned local human-judgment fixture bound to this dataset fingerprint

splitPolicy: chainId belongs to exactly one split
normalized prefix belongs to exactly one split
prefix plus completion target belongs to exactly one split
a hard negative never becomes a positive target for the same prefix
